
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/manwwx129/p/19796971" title="发布于 2026-03-30 17:43">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">大模型之Linux服务器部署大模型</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>一、离线手动安装Ollama（Linux）</h1>
<h1>步骤 1：去有网的电脑 下载 Ollama Linux 二进制包</h1>
<div>&nbsp;打开网址（任意电脑浏览器）：<a href="https://ollama.com/install/linux/ollama-linux-amd64" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ollama.com/install/linux/ollama-linux-amd64</a></div>
<div><em id="__mceDel">会自动下载一个文件：ollama-linux-amd64</em></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<hr>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h2>步骤 2：把文件上传到你的 Linux 服务器</h2>
<div>用工具：</div>
<ul>
<li>Xshell</li>
<li>FinalShell</li>
<li>WinSCP</li>
<li>MobaXterm</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>上传到服务器目录，例如：/root/data/ollama</p>
<h2>步骤 3：给执行权限</h2>
<p>命令：chmod +x&nbsp;/root/data/ollama</p>
<h2>步骤 4：启动服务</h2>
<p>命令：ollama serve</p>
<h2>步骤 5：<em id="__mceDel" style="font-size: 14px">设置开机自启</em></h2>
<p><em style="font-size: 14px">命令：vi /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service</em></p>
<p><em style="font-size: 14px">粘贴下面内容到<em>ollama.service</em></em></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Unit]
Description</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Ollama Service
After</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">network.target

[Service]
ExecStart</span>=/usr/local/bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ollama serve
User</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">root
Restart</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">always
RestartSec</span>=3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

[Install]
WantedBy</span>=multi-user.target</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em style="font-size: 14px">保存退出，依次执行命令：</em></p>
<p><em style="font-size: 14px">systemctl daemon-reload </em></p>
<p><em style="font-size: 14px">systemctl enable ollama </em></p>
<p><em style="font-size: 14px">systemctl start ollama</em></p>
<h2>步骤 6：验证是否安装成功</h2>
<p>命令：ollama --version</p>
<p>出现版本号 = 成功！</p>
<h1>二、离线手动安装大模型（Linux）</h1>
<p>有网机器下载模型包：ollama pull qwen2.5:7b</p>
<p>导出模型：&nbsp;ollama save qwen2.5:7b qwen2.5-7b.tar.gz</p>
<p>上传到离线服务器：ollama load qwen2.5-7b.tar.gz&nbsp; &nbsp;（怎么上传到服务器参考前面说到的步骤2，在上传后的目录下执行命令）</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>开始运行你的大模型&nbsp; 命令：ollama run qwen2.5:7b</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>额外小知识：</h2>
<p>执行脚本 命令：sh&nbsp;&nbsp;<em id="__mceDel">ollama-setup.sh</em></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>#!/bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">bash

# 启用全部 GPU
echo </span>"OLLAMA_NUM_GPU=all" | sudo tee -a /etc/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">environment

# 修改模型存储路径（你可以自己改成你想要的目录）
echo </span>"OLLAMA_MODELS=/data/ollama/models" | sudo tee -a /etc/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">environment

# 重启 ollama 服务
sudo systemctl restart ollama

echo </span>"==================================="<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
echo </span>"✅ GPU 已启用"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
echo </span>"✅ 模型路径已修改为 /data/ollama/models"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
echo </span>"✅ 配置已生效！"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
echo </span>"==================================="</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
